conditions.pe_expressibility_note: The work allowance amounts map to means_test.work_allowance against an uprated modified baseline, but only in the post-2016 two-amount structure; parameters start 2016-04-11.
conditions.pe_missing: pre-April-2016 UC work-allowance schedule (separate higher/lower amounts by family type, including childless claimants) is not representable: is_uc_work_allowance_eligible limits the allowance to families with children or LCWRA and uc_work_allowance has only with/without-housing amounts; and no UC rollout rule (gov.dwp.universal_credit.rollout_rate is read by no formula), so the 2013-2018 UC caseload comes only from data (would_claim_uc)
